constraints: Use .NET/C#, ASP.NET Core, Postgres, and Docker Compose with one local Postgres service and a persistent volume.
Use Vertical Slice Architecture with a minimal shared kernel; do not introduce generic Controller, Service, or Repository layers.
Use real Postgres for integration tests, with isolated and serial test execution; in-memory or mock-only persistence is not acceptable.
Configure the connection through TODO_DB_CONNECTION with only a documented local default; do not expose credentials or internal failure details.
The scope is greenfield, local development/test use only, with no frontend, users/authentication, cloud or production deployment, legacy/JSON migration, or regulated-data claim.
desiredOutcomes: Provide the six task-management operations with a stable JSON and Problem Details HTTP contract.
Persist tasks in a local Postgres database, automatically initialize the schema, and preserve id, title, and status across API-only restarts.
Provide idempotent local startup and a single verification flow covering pure unit tests and real HTTP/Postgres integration tests.
Keep endpoint behavior cohesive through vertical slices while validating inputs and sanitizing dependency failures.

problem: A local HTTP consumer needs a reliable way to create, query, filter, complete, edit, and remove tasks, with real Postgres persistence and reproducible verification instead of transient or legacy-file storage.
title: Local TodoApp WebAPI with persistent task management
users: Unauthenticated local HTTP clients managing tasks
Developers building and maintaining the API and local infrastructure
Testers and reviewers verifying rules, endpoints, persistence, and failures
